name: Pineapple Bread
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Add the banana to a medium bowl, and mash it with a fork. Cut the pineapple into small pieces and mix them into the banana.
In a separate large bowl, combine all dry ingredients except coconut flakes.
Put the butter, eggs, milk and fruits into the second bowl and beat well. As the actual water content of fruits can vary, add an additional tbsp or two of flour if the mixture appears too wet.
Lightly grease or line an 8x4 in (20x10 cm) loaf pan.
Sprinkle a thin layer of coconut flakes on top.
Bake on middle shelf of oven for 60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.
